brief: Concrete stave silo about 14 ft across and 45 ft high whose staves were painted in alternating white and brick-red checks, now chalky and rust-streaked so the pattern reads as a patchy red-and-white checkerboard, bound with steel hoops. Topped by a bright galvanized steel dome roof with a small hatch; a white vertical pipe climbs the front and a small white block silo room stands at its foot. It rises against the gable of a weathered grey plank barn with a green roof.
